svg.title: Plant Monitor v1 wiring diagram
svg.text: Plant Monitor v1 function demo - wiring (top view, schematic style, not to scale)
Same colour or same net tag = same wire. Pins per firmware/main/board.h. Never plug both USB-C ports; open J1 before USB-C on the SuperMini.
OUT = protected side: the load connects only here
W02: J1 pin A to R1 top (5V_SW, dashed, insulated)
J1 open: R1 has no source, GPIO0 = 0 V
USB-C (program) at top, antenna at bottom end
plug wire colours UNVERIFIED: confirm by continuity
pin order UNVERIFIED: read the silk
Net tags (same tag = same wire; routed on the board, see wire table):
SuperMini 3V3 -> BH1750 VCC, AHT20 VIN, Rp1, Rp2 (W06, W07, W10)
OUT-, SuperMini G -> BH1750 GND + ADDR, AHT20 GND, J3 GND (W04..W12)
GPIO6 -> Rp1 -> BH1750 SDA, AHT20 SDA (W13..W15)
GPIO7 -> Rp2 -> BH1750 SCL, AHT20 SCL (W16..W18)
Pull-ups Rp1/Rp2 5.1k to 3V3: fit only if the breakouts have none (4.3).
